title: Fence type changes to and from hierarchy types against concurrent attaches in kanbus-api
description: Follow-up from PR #510: changing an issue's type to or from a hierarchy type returns 409 type_change_unsupported because a concurrent attach could otherwise leave a child that violates the hierarchy. Fence it with the relations record (mark the record during a type change the way deletes do, leased), then allow type changes that keep the hierarchy valid with the parent and every live child. Spec with interleaving tests like tests/relations.rs.
